$comment: Canonical demo input/output set. One entry per feature shown in the product video. Every entry starts from an initialised surface - a new conversation, an empty pane - so nothing depends on leftover state or on a live tenant. Fabricated throughout.
world: Plain project, customer, operations and quality-review work. The same world as sample-data/demo-project and sample-data/iq-cells.

entries.openingState: New conversation. No history, no attachments.

input.label: First message
input.text: What meetings do I have tomorrow, and who is attending?

transport.account: The server holds its own Microsoft 365 account. IQ Compiler never hands it a token.
transport.risk: read — no approval card, because nothing leaves the tenant

output.label: Answer
output.title: Tuesday 2 September — 4 meetings
output.marking: The result is marked untrusted. Content that came from outside is data, not an instruction.

entries.narrationClaim: Reading the calendar asks nothing. Sending mail would ask every time.

entries.openingState: Empty research pane. One topic field.

output.label: Report
output.title: Research: sovereign cloud · 12.8 KB Markdown
output.body: A sovereign cloud is a cloud environment designed to satisfy a jurisdiction's digital-sovereignty requirements: data governance, residency, access, encryption keys, compliance and operational authority.[3][4]
output.coverage: Every question in the plan was answered with at least one citation.

entries.narrationClaim: A topic goes in. A cited report comes out.

entries.openingState: Empty council pane. Three members loaded, no question yet.

input.label: Question
input.text: The customer portal release is failing 3% of its automated checks. Do we ship on the promised date, or hold two weeks?

output.label: Verdict
output.title: Council verdict · Confidence: medium
output.recommendation: Do not ship on the promised date with the checks failing. Run a 48-hour diagnostic gate, and hold the release the moment the failure reproduces.
dissent: Send the two-week notice today. A moved date is recoverable; a broken portal in front of a customer is not.
Send no notice yet. Replanning costs become real the moment they are announced.
output.counts: 7 decision criteria · 5 open questions still recorded

entries.narrationClaim: A decision goes in. A verdict with its dissent comes out.

entries.feature: Ask the published Fabric Data Agent in plain language
entries.openingState: New conversation. The published Fabric Data Agent endpoint is already connected.

input.label: Question
input.text: Which customers had more than two open issues last quarter?

transport.account: Azure identity. The same sign-in you use, nothing stored.
transport.risk: read — the agent answers over the semantic model, it does not write to it

tools.name: fabric_ask_data_agent
tools.why: put the question to the published agent

output.label: Answer
output.title: 4 customers
output.query:
EVALUATE
  FILTER(
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
      Customer[Name],
      "Open", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Issue), Issue[Status] = "Open")
    ),
    [Open] > 2
  )
output.note: The generated query stays on screen. You can read what was asked of the model, not only what came back.

entries.narrationClaim: The answer comes back from Fabric, and the query that produced it stays on screen.

entries.feature: Build a document and watch it being written
entries.openingState: Empty Office pane. No file open.

input.label: Instruction
input.text: Turn the customer portal review notes into a six-slide overview deck. Give every slide a title and a body.

output.label: Deck
output.title: portal-review-overview.pptx · 6 slides
rows: What the checks are telling us
What the customer has been told
output.note: Content preview sits in the same workspace. You can read slide 3 while slide 5 is still being written.

entries.narrationClaim: The file is inspectable while it is still being written.

entries.feature: Generate an image, then edit a painted region

input.label: Prompt
input.text: A flat vector infographic for a quarterly business review. A 2x2 grid of four panels labelled Revenue, Cost, Headcount, Risk. Deep navy background, white text, a single orange accent colour.

output.label: Image + provenance
output.title: qbr-infographic.png · 1024 × 1024
output.provenance: Model, size, endpoint and correlation id are written beside the file.

edit.label: Then edit it
edit.text: Paint the region. Describe the change.
edit.appQuote: The area is a hint, not a boundary — the model often adjusts pixels just outside it so the edit blends in.
edit.note: The application says so on screen. No hidden behaviour.

entries.narrationClaim: This is visible work: the prompt, the file and the edit are all on screen.

entries.feature: Turn a repeated task into a named skill

input.label: What you do
input.text: Record yourself doing the task once. Analysis does not start until you tick the consent box.

output.label: Skill proposal
output.title: Weekly portal review pack · proposed
rows: You edit what the app thinks happened
Nothing is built until you say yes
A named skill, with its allowed tools written separately
output.note: The skill body and its allowed-tools list are separate files. A skill cannot widen its own permission.

entries.feature: A recording becomes decisions and action items you approve

input.label: What goes in
input.text: A 32-minute meeting recording. Transcription runs on the device.

output.label: Notes awaiting review
output.title: Change board · CHANGE-2214 · 32:14
rows: Hold the portal release until the check failure reproduces
Customer update goes out Thursday, not today
Rebuild the review pack with dated evidence
output.note: Every line keeps the timestamp it came from. Nothing is filed until a person approves it.

entries.narrationClaim: Each line keeps the second of the recording it came from.
